rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same site dates to 10 May 1994 Mandela's address 'at his inauguration as President of South Africa, Pretoria', in which he speaks of the honour of being 'the first President of a united, democratic, non-racial and non-sexist government' and names F. W. de Klerk as his Second Deputy President.
